name: Launchbuff
tagline: LaunchBuff is a recurring product competition built for indie founders who are tired of one-shot launches that disappear in 24 hours
description: LaunchBuff is a recurring product competition built for indie founders who are tired of one-shot launches that disappear in 24 hours. Every two weeks, 16 products enter a bracket tournament. Over 10 days, the community votes on head-to-head matchups — but only after visiting both products. Four rounds. One champion.
